name: Feature request

## Summary

A short description of the feature (1–2 sentences).

## Problem / motivation

What problem does this solve? Who is affected and how often?

## Proposed solution

How should this work? Include interface sketches, API proposals, or configuration examples if relevant.

## Alternatives considered

Have you considered other approaches? Why is this solution better?

## Additional context

Links to related issues, research papers, or prior art.
